1.bug_scenario: The bug relates to an accessibility issue in the Date Picker component. When the user opens the calendar by clicking the calendar icon, they are unable to navigate the date picker with the keyboard, meaning assistive technologies or keyboard-only users cannot select dates as expected. However, if the calendar is opened by focusing or clicking the input field, keyboard navigation works fine. The provided images show the two scenarios: the first with the calendar open from the icon (no blue focus ring, probably not focus-trapped), and the second with the calendar open from the input (blue focus ring visible, keyboard access functional). This indicates an issue in how focus management is handled when the calendar is triggered by the icon button.
